in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tullia הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Roman family name Tullius, Tullia means 'daughter, little one'. in_latin.name: Tullia
in_latin.meaning: Tullia, feminine form of Tullius, possibly derived from Latin name Tullus, related to 'tulere' meaning to bear or endure
in_latin.long_meaning: Tullia, in Latin tradition, is derived from the name Tullius, which is possibly related to the Latin verb 'tulere,' meaning to bear or endure. This name has its roots in the early Christian tradition, where it was used to signify strength and resilience. In the context of Christian naming, Tullia is often associated with the virtues of patience and endurance, as exemplified by the biblical figures who demonstrated such qualities in the face of adversity. Historically, the name Tullia was also used in ancient Rome, where it was borne by several women of noble birth. Today, Tullia remains a popular choice for Christian parents seeking a name that reflects the values of faith and perseverance.
